cohort: The cohort included 30,868 women who delivered at seven university-affiliated hospitals in Israel, divided into a conflict-exposed group (delivering during October 7, 2023 – April 7, 2024) and a control group (delivering during the same period the previous year).
finding: Exposure to wartime conditions is independently associated with an increased risk of various pregnancy and delivery complications, including premature rupture of membranes (PROM), preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM), gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), and postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
